comparison.objective: Zip an already-started jacket while pinning the garment.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization of a deformable garment, small pull-tab grasping, force-guided sliding, and regrasping.
comparison.success_condition: Slider within 3 mm of the top, both grippers over 40 mm clear, and the zipper pin never protruding over 3 mm. Fabric or zipper damage is otherwise unspecified.
comparison.reason: Deformable garment stabilization and zipper travel are materially different from rigid-body granular separation.
